_comment: M42/T42.5 (R18-F2, docs/plan-drive-identity.md §2.4): what scripts/drive/run.py must discover under widgets/ before it opens any window.
Edited by hand, never generated from the inventories: a manifest read from what it checks is the tautology this replaces.
A removal fails; an addition fails until this file names it, so the change is visible in the diff.
`static` lists every action that is not checked for landing; `counts` pins actions, landed-checked (non-static) and isolated (T42.6).
M44/T44.10 added Select and ScrollView (owed since M42) and a keyboard action each to PickList, ColorPicker, Tree (two) and DataGrid.
M45/T45.6 added word-Left, double click and triple click to TextInput and TextArea, and Ctrl+End and Home to TextArea.
The M56 merge made NumberInput's letter refusal static: its landing had been read off the click inside `do`, never off the letters.
M80/T80.2 added Label: its demo's switch sets a 1.5x line height through the program's style_by, and a second press restores it.
M80/T80.3 added Label's ellipsis switch: one press cuts the paragraph to one line (the whole text still published), a second wraps it again.
M80/T80.4 added Selectable: a drag across the first line, then app.copy (copied and clipboard equal); a double click copies one word. A press outside clears it (both isolates).

M81/T81.6 added TextInput RTL (`שלום world 123`, driven by the +shaping legs): a click at the visual left end, then a character, appends at the logical end; a press above it types nowhere (the isolate).
M82/T82.3 added Card's static fill check: its centre and side pixels differ by at least 16 levels (a radial, by role) and its corner pixel is the stage behind it (rounded).
M82/T82.5 added PaintBox's static path check: the star the callback fills with Painter::path covers at least 90% of its analytic outline in its colour, and none of that colour is outside the box.

M82/T82.8 added VectorText's two static checks: the 90° run's ink, read from the screenshot, is at least twice as tall as wide with none outside its box, and the node publishes "Vertical" as its value, which ~=Vertical resolves to.

M84/T84.3 added Image: a second of playing presents 10 ± 1 frames at 1.00x the image's box and moves its pixels (paused, the same wait presents 0); a press pauses and holds the frame, a second resumes; and K84c's static check, the median layout per animated frame against 100 µs.

M84/T84.8 added Video: play changes the picture within 250 ms; pause flips the button to Play and holds the picture over 500 ms; a press at 75% of the track hands on_seek 0.75 and shows frame 3 at 300 ms; a drag 25% -> 50% while playing ends at 50% with no frame from a stopped feed; and the static check that a press on the picture is not handled and changes nothing.
M85/T85.1 added Layout: a static geometry check that a flexible(1) bar with 80 px of content is min(80, row/2) wide beside a fill that takes the rest, on one line.

M85/T85.2 added Pin: a static check that the pinned button sits at the pin's origin plus (112, 64), inside the pin; and a click on it moves the press counter by one with the damage over the pin at 1.00x the button's own box.

Selectable: a drag across the first line selects its words, and app.copy puts them on the clipboard
a double click copies one word
PickList: releasing over a row chooses it
a picklist does not filter on its trigger
the keyboard walks the list and chooses a row
Combobox: a press on a filtered row chooses that row
after a choice a press on the field opens the list again
clearing the query shows everything again
Menu: it shows its commands with no trigger
choosing a command runs it and closes the menu
Pagination: the next arrow steps one page
pressing a number goes to that page
the keyboard jumps to the last page
a number is the page it shows, not its position in the strip
the previous arrow steps back, it does not jump
the first page is always one press away
Tree: pressing a parent folds its whole subtree away
pressing a leaf selects it and folds nothing
a hover lights the row under the pointer
the keyboard folds the lit parent
DataGrid: it shows its columns over virtualized rows
a wheel scrolls the rows under the header
a press on a row selects it
a press on a cell makes that cell active
the arrows move the active cell
dragging the thumb scrolls the rows
Ctrl+End from a focused cell brings the last row into view
NumberInput: ArrowUp steps it up by exactly one step
RangeSlider: a press takes the nearer handle and moves it
a handle driven past the other stops at it
SearchField: a click reaches the text, not the container
the magnifier is left of the text and inside the pill
clicking a full field twice on one spot leaves its view still
Escape clears the query, and the field ends inside the pill
Wrap: six chips land on more than one line
every child is inside the container it reported
Grid: six badges land on exactly two rows of three
Layout: a flexible bar keeps its content up to half; the fill takes the rest
SplitPane: it stops short of the edge
Accordion: a press on the header opens the section
a press on the header again closes it
opening one closes the one that was open
PaneGrid: a column's divider moves only that column
a drag keeps the divider it started on
Tabs: a press selects the item under it
a press on the item already selected changes nothing but is taken
BottomNav: a press selects the item under it
a press on the item already selected changes nothing but is taken
NavigationRail: a press selects the item under it
a press on the item already selected changes nothing but is taken
AppBar: it shows its title and does not grow with it
PullToRefresh: a wheel pull past the threshold refreshes when the wheel stops
a short pull springs back without refreshing
an upward wheel is not a pull
ColorPicker: a cell sets the value and closes the popup
a press outside closes it and changes nothing
the keyboard walks the swatches and chooses one
DatePicker: a cell sets the value and closes the popup
a press outside closes it and changes nothing
the arrows page the month and leave the chosen date
a day picked after paging commits the paged month
TimePicker: a cell sets the value and closes the popup
a press outside closes it and changes nothing
an hour sets the hour and keeps the clock open
FilePicker: a cell sets the value and closes the popup
a press outside closes it and changes nothing
RichText: it publishes what a reader sees, and wraps to fit
Markdown: the markers are markup, not text
RichTextEditor: typing markup updates the preview under it
PaintBox: the application's drawing is on screen and inside the box
the star path is filled inside its own outline
Select: pressing the trigger opens the menu
releasing over a row chooses it and closes the menu
the keyboard opens it, walks the rows and chooses one
Escape closes it and focus returns to the trigger
ScrollView: PageDown from a focused row scrolls the view
a drag on the bar scrolls it
Card: a button on the card reaches the application
the content is inset by the card's padding
the card's fill is a rounded radial
Pin: the button sits at the pin's origin plus its offset
a click on the pinned button reaches the application
Toast: Save shows a toast below the stage, centred on the window
it shrinks to its text rather than filling the window
shown again, it goes away by itself
it paints a ground, so its light text is readable
Tooltip: resting on the content opens the tip
the tip does not take the pointer from its content
TextInput: backspace removes the character before the caret
a word-Left moves the caret to the word's start
a double click selects the word under it
a triple click selects the whole value
TextInput RTL: a click at the visual left end then a character appends at the logical end
TextArea: a paste keeps its line breaks, as one edit
Ctrl+End goes to the end of the text
Home goes to the line's start
a word-Left moves the caret to the word's start
a double click selects the word under it
a triple click selects the line
Slider: a click sets the value to where it landed
End takes it to the maximum
Home takes it to the minimum
an arrow moves it by one step, not to an end
Label: the switch sets a 1.5x line height and the paragraph is lines x pitch
a second press restores the face's spacing
the ellipsis switch cuts the paragraph to one line, and it still publishes the whole text
a second press wraps the paragraph again
Button: a held press shows on the button
hovering is visible and is not a press
CheckBox: a click flips the bound flag
a second click flips it back
the second checkbox is independently addressable
a click on its words flips it
Switch: a click flips the bound flag
the track changes colour with the state
Radio: clicking the other option moves the selection
Down moves the selection to the next option
Chip: the × removes and does not select
Modal: a press on the scrim asks to dismiss
the control on the panel still reaches the application
Sheet: a press on the scrim asks to dismiss
the control on the panel still reaches the application
Drawer: a press on the scrim asks to dismiss
the control on the panel still reaches the application
VectorText: it speaks its text, and ~= finds it
Image: K84c: the whole-tree mark per animated frame is priced
Video: a press at 75% of the track seeks there
a drag from 25% to 50% ends at 50%, and no frame from before it lands after it
a press on the picture changes nothing
